svg.text: V2X ECU call flow, 1 of 3 — start-up
No traffic reaches the network during start-up. Each call is acknowledged, and each acknowledgement is logged.
bind UDP 47100, start the receive thread
Injected fault: the call fails, the failure and its recovery are logged, and the
call is retried with backoff. On exhaustion the process exits and the node restarts.
